Commentary.Commentary: Done with this match and we quickly move on to the next. Yes, it's on Sunday at the same venue in Florida. Do join us at 1030 local time (1430 GMT) for all the action. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli says that their bowling and fielding were right up there and feels the pitch wasn't too great. Calls it a sluggish wicket and mentions that it was a top effort from his bowlers. Shares that Navdeep had a great last season in the Indian T20 League and he is a raw talent who can bowl in the 150s. He hopes that he builds from here on. Tells that they lost a couple of wickets more than they would have liked. Further says that the new ball was coming on decently but as it got older, stroke-making wasn't easy and strike rotation was the key. Just wants his players to keep performing and contribute to the game.
MAN OF THE MATCH IS NAVDEEP SAINI! No interview taken.

West Indian skipper, Carlos Brathwaite says that they didn't assess the conditions well and praises Kieron Pollard for batting well. Feels 130-140 would have been more challenging. Lack of assessment early enough cost them, he states. Wants his team to play with positive and aggressive intent but at the same time, he wants his players to assess the conditions better. Tells that Narine's four overs in any cricket is vital and lauds his pacers for setting it up well.

Daren Ganga is taking Sunil Narine's interview who has had a good comeback for West Indies. The mystery off spinner says that it's always great to be back in maroon and he is always proud to play for West Indies. Informs that he is nearly fit but his finger is still not 100 percent. Adds that they have to play positive cricket and start well in the Powerplay. Mentions that the coming opportunities are crucial and he wants to be prepared for the World T20. No new innovation in his game, he informs and further states that he is focusing on enjoying cricket.

The visitors fielded an inexperienced bowling attack but the bowlers took the opportunity and proved themselves. Navdeep Saini had a dream debut as he picked up a 3-wicket haul while the other bowlers also left their mark. Apart from Kieron Pollard, there wasn't any fight shown by the West Indian batsmen. During the chase, India kept losing wickets but at the same time, they kept on scoring runs as well. Eventually, the depth in their batting took them over the line and handed the Blue team lead in this 3-match series.

India have limped to a win here in Miami! They made a mountain out of a molehill and nearly made a mess of a simple target. West Indies would be thinking that had they got 40-50 runs more, they could have come out on top. Looking at the approach by the Indian batsmen in the run chase, the Men in Blue will be thanking their bowlers for restricting the opposition for a paltry total.
SIX! All over! INDIA WIN BY 4 WICKETS! A slower delivery, shorter in length around off, Sundar attacks it with all his power and dismisses it over long on for a maximum.
Full toss outside off, Sundar taps it down to point.
A dot to end as the ball is defended to the man at covers.
EDGY! Slower length ball close to off stump, Sundar pushes inside the line and edges it past the diving keeper to third man. Thomas makes a diving stop and the batsmen take a run.
A near yorker on off, Sundar brings down a straight bat and pushes it back to the bowler.
Fullish and around leg, Jadeja clips it through square leg for one.
Another slower delivery, around off, Sundar is early into the flick shot and it goes off the leading edge towards point. A single taken again.
Slower delivery on middle and leg, Jadeja nudges it to fine leg for one.
Washington Sundar walks out to bat.
India are making this run chase interesting by losing wickets at regular intervals.

OUT! Another wicket goes down! Paul steams in from 'round the wicket and angles in a length ball around middle and off at 128 kph. Pandya is early into his attempted flick shot and hence misses the ball completely. The ball doesn't miss the stumps though. India are 8 runs away from a win with 4 wickets left.
Short and around leg, Krunal tries to pull but fails to connect properly. It rolls down towards short fine leg.
A low full toss outside off, Jadeja digs it out down to third man for a run.
Shortish and slower in pace, Jadeja pulls but finds mid-wicket.
Full again and this time it's been driven through covers for one.
Fullish and on off, Jadeja drives it down through mid off for a run.

Almost drags it on! Around off, Pandya tries to drive but it takes the inside edge and strikes him on the pads. It ricochets behind and misses the off stump by a whisker. 12 from the over, 11 needed more.
FOUR! Cracking sound of the bat meeting the ball! Short in length, around middle at 123 kph, Krunal picks it early and dismisses it from his sight by pulling it to the deep square leg fence.
Sliding down the leg side, nudged to fine leg for one.

Short delivery on middle, it's pulled powerfully through mid-wicket. Brathwaite gives the chase and pulls the ball back just before the rope. In fact the ball had itself stopped. The batsmen taken three.

Sweet timing! Misfield. Two runs taken in the end. Fullish and on off, Jadeja drives it through covers and crosses for a run. Lewis attacks the ball in the deep, overruns a bit and the ball goes through. The batsmen complete two and take one more off the misfield. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Carlos Brathwaite is lazy in backing up but no extra run taken.
Width on offer outside off, Krunal throws his bat at it and it goes off the outside edge to third man. A single is taken.
Oshane Thomas returns for another burst.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Jadeja steers it behind backward point for a couple of runs.
Again a wide! Another one down the leg side, Ravindra tries to get some bat behind but misses.
Wide! Cottrell attempts for the magic delivery first up but ends up slipping it down the leg side.
Ravindra Jadeja walks in next.

OUT! Here comes the salute! Virat Kohli has disappointment written all over his face. He is completely fooled here by a slower delivery bowled at 112 kph. The length is short and outside off, Virat has his weight on the back leg as he tries to fetch it and pull it on the leg side. But the ball arrives late, takes the top edge and lobs up towards mid-wicket. Kieron Pollard won't drop those. Are we in for something here? 27 still needed off 37 balls.
Hits the blockhole at 131 kph, Pandya digs it out towards mid on for a run.
Back of a length delivery on off, slower in pace at 123 kph, Pandya punches it from the crease to covers.
Krunal shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot
On and around off, Pandya is on top of the bounce as he defends it down.
Bowling change. Sheldon Cottrell is back on.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it through mid off for a run. Narine has finished his spell, 4-0-14-2, a brilliant comeback for him personally!
This one is on the leg stump line, Krunal tries flicking but misses and is hit on the pads.
Tossed up ball on off, this time Kohli works it down through mid on and rotates the strike.
Gets forward to a full ball and drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Flatter on off, Virat moves across and punches it towards mid-wicket again.
Too full in length on off, Kohli works it on the leg side but finds mid-wicket.
Sunil Narine is back on.
Knocks a full ball down through mid on for a run. 30 more needed off 48 balls.
Short in length on middle and leg, Krunal gets hurried into his pull shot and it comes off his gloves. It rolls behind square leg and they cross.
Krunal Pandya walks in next.

OUT! Off stump goes cartwheeling! Manish Pandey is gone and Virat Kohli is not looking too impressed. Keemo Paul slants in a fuller length ball on off, the pace is right up there, at 135 kph, Pandey plays all over it as he tries to whip it across the line. The ball sneaks under his bat and uproots the off stump.
Slower one outside off, Pandey slaps it through covers for a couple of runs.
Angling into the batsman, Kohli chips it over mid on and takes a single.
A full toss on middle, it's clipped across the line to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Keemo Paul is back on.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and outside off, pushed through mid on for a single.
Close call. Kohli dabs this towards third man and sets off for a single. Pooran quickly gets across to his right and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Looks like Pandey would have been in.
Landed outside off, steered through point for a run.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
FOUR! FETCH THAT! Kohli welcomes his counterpart in style. A length ball, outside off, Kohli jumps out of his crease and slaps it over point for a boundary.
Carlos Brathwaite comes on.
Outside off, another one of those repetitive dabs to third man to get a single.
Around off, solidly defended.
Outside off, short in length, Manish arches back, then rises with the bounce to guide the ball towards third man for a run. This was what Hetmyer was trying to do while batting, but dragged it on.
Down the leg side, helped through square leg for one more. 50 UP FOR INDIA, at a touch slow rate than they would have anticipated but given the situation of the game, it is fine.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
FOUR! GLORIOUS! Full and outside off, Pandey leans and drives it wide of cover for a boundary!
Short and outside off, punched through point for a couple.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Outside off, worked towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Outside off, punched towards long on for a single.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, pushed through mid on for a run.
Outside off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
WIDE. Full toss down the leg side, left alone.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Full and outside off, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! FEROCIOUS! Full and outside off, Pandey hammers this straight back past the bowler and beats mid off. Great shot.
Keemo Paul has come into the attack.
Full and down the leg side, Virat looks to flick but misses. 2 runs and a 2 wickets from the over, Narine's figures read 2-0-9-2.
Full and around off, driven through mid on for a single.
Manish Pandey walks in at number 5, replacing Pant.

OUT! Caught as well! Unbelievable. Utterly needless cricket by Pant. For the second time in the game, a bowler is on a hat-trick. Pant will have to probably give a long lecture to Kohli on being asked as to why, why, why mate why, this shot on the first ball of the tour. Full and outside off, Pant gets down and mows the slog sweep. But there is a top edge which goes towards Sheldon Cottrell at deep backward square leg, who completes the catch running to his right. Pant looks at his feet, not daring to look at his skipper, before slowly walking off.
Rishabh Pant comes in at number 4, replacing Rohit.

OUT! Caught! Rohit finds his Mumbai teammate to perfection. This is the 8th time Narine has dismissed Sharma in all T20s combined. Full and outside off, RS looks to heave it over the on side but does not get any elevation. Simple catch to Kieron Pollard at long on.
Outside off, pushed straight to point.
Full and around off, worked towards mid-wicket for a single. There is a misfield and Rohit thinks about the second but then lets it be.
Outside off, fuller in length, nicely blocked out.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
SIX! GORGEOUS! Wow. Rohit is slowly getting into good flow. Full and outside off, Rohit leans and lofts it cleanly over extra cover! It is an 87-metre hit.
Outside off, played towards point.
Fielding changes galore. Hetmyer is moved from short mid-wicket to deep mid-wicket, someone else is moved to long on while third man comes up.
FOUR! This was what Kohli was trying on the previous ball. A length ball outside off, Rohit heaves it wide of long on and gets a boundary!
Full and outside off, Kohli flicks it ala flamingo style towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Kohli punches this well wide of short mid-wicket towards long on for one.
On middle and off, Sharma punches this towards long on but waits. Because there is a short mid-wicket in place. But the fielder gets across, slides and misses. Now, the batsmen run.
Around off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, spinning in, RS goes for a mighty slog but misses and is hit on the pads. Narine appeals but that was going down the leg side.
FOUR! Poor ball. Short and wide outside off, Rohit goes back and cuts it superbly between backward point and short third man. Excellent bisection.
Full and outside off, worked towards long on for a single.
Sunil Narine is introduced into the attack.
An inswinging yorker on off, Rohit digs it out to the off side to cap off a brilliant over by Sheldon.
Full toss on off, Sharma pushes it out on the off side, finds the cover fielder.
Cottrell delivers it full and on middle, a little bit of swing there, Kohli is opened up in his defense and it goes off the leading edge to the off side. It's in the gap and they cross for a run.
What a delivery! Cottrell spears in a cracking yorker on middle, Rohit is lucky to have his bat down in time and it takes the outside edge before hurrying down to third man. They pick up a single.
Fuller and wide outside off, Rohit flashes and misses.
Fullish and on off, Sharma gets forward and pushes it down off the inside half to mid on.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. 7 runs from the over!
Shortish and on off, defended from the crease to the off side.
Just short of third man! Short in length and outside off, Rohit plays the upper cut but without much conviction. It flies and falls in front of the diving third man fielder. A single is taken.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

SIX! Not in much control but still it has gone all the way. Such is the pace of this bowler. He delivers it short around middle and leg, Rohit top edges his attempted pull shot and it flies over fine leg.
Back of a length ball on off, Sharma blocks it off his back foot.
Virat Kohli walks in next at number 3.

OUT! Dhawan is adjudged lbw! Dots after dots after dots and that results in a wicket. Dhawan was struggling to find the gap on the off side and hence decides to go over the leg side. Cottrell angles in a length ball on middle and off, Shikhar finds the angle to his use as he attempts to heave it over mid-wicket. But he fails to put bat on ball and is rapped right in front of the wickets. The appeal is made and the finger goes up in no time. Dhawan knows he is a dead duck and walks back. First wicket for West Indies but they need to keep chipping away at wickets if they want to compete in this match.
Wicket to wicket line, around off, Dhawan covers the line and defends it out with a straight bat.
Wide! Cottrell this time drifts down the leg side, it's so wide that even Dhawan thought that it's useless to throw his bat at it.
Another dot delivery. Shortish ball on off, Shikhar punches from the back foot but finds the point fielder. Not able to find the gaps.
Good length ball on off, Dhawan punches it from the back foot to covers.
Wide! Cottrell gets his wrists wrong at the point of delivery. Loses his direction and sprays a length ball way wide outside off. Dhawan leaves and the umpire exercises his arms.
Angles in a length ball on off, Dhawan takes a stride forward and pushes it to covers.
Shortish and outside off, Dhawan keeps his weight on the back foot and punches it square of the wicket on the off side. Finds point.
Sheldon Cottrell to bowl from the other end. Will we get to see his salute today?
Thomas tries the follow-up delivery to be a yorker but it turns out to be a full toss on the pads. Sharma flicks but finds the mid-wicket fielder.
Play and a miss! Shortish and wide outside off, a speedy delivery, Rohit throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Back of a length ball on off, Dhawan stands tall inside the crease and guides it down to third man for a run. He opens his account with that.
India are away! Fractionally short and around off, Sharma stays back and taps it down in front of backward point for a quick run.
Rohit finds the middle of his bat this time. He plays it with angle of the bowler and pushes it out to mid-wicket.
Starts with a good length ball around off, angling in, Sharma tries defending with a half front foot stride but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

In a huddle are West Indies. Talking to his troops is Carlos Brathwaite. Don't think there is much to say at this stage apart from trying your best and sticking to the basics. Rohit Sharma is reunited with Shikhar Dhawan at the top after the southpaw pulled out from the middle of the World Cup. Oshane Thomas to speed in first up...
